boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented Nimitz Library settings for solo, group, classroom, and archival work.

cards.title: Nimitz Library Room 301
cards.subtitle: Third floor reservable group room
cards.notes: Reserve this eight-person room when your group needs a whiteboard, screen, and VHS/DVD player; leave time to make the reservation before arrival.
cards.short_summary: A reservable third-floor room with group presentation tools.
cards.evidence_claim: Nimitz Library lists Room 301 as a reservable third-floor room for eight people with a whiteboard, screen, and VHS/DVD player.
cards.access_notes: Reservations may be made 7 days to 4 hours ahead; when unreserved, the room is first come, first served.

cards.title: Nimitz Library Room 302
cards.subtitle: Third floor reservable small group room
cards.notes: Use this four-person room for a compact working session with a whiteboard, chalkboard, and white-noise machine; reserve a slot before you go.
cards.short_summary: A small reservable room with multiple writing surfaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Nimitz Library lists Room 302 as a reservable third-floor room for four people with a whiteboard, chalkboard, and white-noise machine.
cards.access_notes: Reservations may be made 7 days to 4 hours ahead; when unreserved, the room is first come, first served.

cards.title: Nimitz Library Room 303
cards.subtitle: Third floor reservable individual desk
cards.notes: Book this one-person room when you want a defined desk and door; check the reservation calendar early because an active booking takes priority.
cards.short_summary: A reservable third-floor room designed around one desk.
cards.evidence_claim: Nimitz Library lists Room 303 as a reservable third-floor room with an individual desk and capacity for one person.
cards.access_notes: Reservations may be made 7 days to 4 hours ahead; when unreserved, the room is first come, first served.

cards.title: Nimitz Library Room 304
cards.subtitle: Third floor reservable individual desk
cards.notes: Choose this one-person desk room for a self-directed session; make a reservation and yield the space if another user has an active booking.
cards.short_summary: A second reservable individual-desk option on the third floor.
cards.evidence_claim: Nimitz Library lists Room 304 as a reservable third-floor room with an individual desk and capacity for one person.
cards.access_notes: Reservations may be made 7 days to 4 hours ahead; when unreserved, the room is first come, first served.

cards.title: Nimitz Library Room 313
cards.subtitle: Third floor collaboration-table room
cards.notes: Reserve this four-person room when you need to share a laptop display through HDMI; use the rolling whiteboard for planning and problem-solving.
cards.short_summary: A reservable collaboration room with HDMI display sharing.
cards.evidence_claim: Nimitz Library lists Room 313 as a reservable third-floor room for four people with a collaboration table, HDMI-connected screen, and rolling whiteboard.
cards.access_notes: Reservations may be made 7 days to 4 hours ahead; when unreserved, the room is first come, first served.

cards.title: Nimitz Library Room 315
cards.subtitle: Third floor reservable group room
cards.notes: Set up a four-person review session here with the chalkboard and rolling whiteboard; confirm the calendar before relying on the room.
cards.short_summary: A reservable third-floor group room with chalkboard space.
cards.evidence_claim: Nimitz Library lists Room 315 as a reservable third-floor room for four people with a chalkboard and a rolling whiteboard.
cards.access_notes: Reservations may be made 7 days to 4 hours ahead; when unreserved, the room is first come, first served.

cards.title: Nautilus Room
cards.subtitle: Nimitz Library main-floor classroom
cards.notes: Check the posted schedule and use this main-floor classroom for individual or group work only when library instruction, meetings, and events are not in session.
cards.short_summary: An open-lab classroom when it is not needed for library instruction.
cards.evidence_claim: Nimitz Library says anyone in the library may use the Nautilus Room for individual or group study when it is not in use for another purpose.
cards.access_notes: Library classes, meetings, and events take priority; consult the schedule posted on or near the door.

cards.title: Nimitz Library Room 227
cards.subtitle: Nimitz Library classroom
cards.notes: Use Ni227 as an individual or group work room when its posted schedule is clear; be ready to choose another spot when a library event has priority.
cards.short_summary: A classroom that can function as open study space between scheduled uses.
cards.evidence_claim: Nimitz Library says anyone in the library may use Ni227 for individual or group study when it is not in use for another purpose.
cards.access_notes: Library classes, meetings, and events take priority; consult the schedule posted on or near the door.

cards.title: Annapolis Room
cards.subtitle: Special Collections & Archives, Nimitz Library third deck
cards.notes: Arrange access with Special Collections & Archives for source-based research in this 24-seat room; staff retrieve collection material and it stays in the room.
cards.short_summary: A 24-seat archival research room on Nimitz Library's third deck.
cards.evidence_claim: USNA Special Collections & Archives identifies the Annapolis Room as a 24-seat third-deck research room where collection material is used on site.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday by appointment; researchers must register, and collections do not leave the Annapolis Room.

cards.title: Nimitz Library Room 306
cards.subtitle: Nimitz Library third-deck silent study room
cards.notes: Bring headphones and keep conversations elsewhere when working in this designated silent room; move group discussion to another library space.
cards.short_summary: A designated silent-study room for focused individual work.
cards.evidence_claim: Nimitz Library designated Ni306 on the third deck as a silent study room and directs conversations and group work to other library spaces.
cards.access_notes: Use headphones for media and take conversations or group work to other library spaces.
